tokens.v: Crop to his jaw, ear and the near cup worn in place, eyes closed out of frame above, chin dropped a degree as if the first note just landed. 100mm at f/2.8 level with the ear cup: the copper hinge fires one clean specular, the leather pad compresses softly against his jaw, the precise low side part holding its line above. His collarbone and a charcoal crew neckline fade through the bottom edge; the headband arc runs out the top-right corner. Skin keeps true texture through the falloff; an unlettered blind-debossed maker's mark in the leather pad pools shadow in its impression.
